titulo: Full moon tonight. Let it go.
caption:
Full moon tonight. Let it go.

Three steps: write down what weighs on you, say it out loud, leave the page on the window.

Comment "go" when it is done. Link in bio.
by NMR
#fullmoon #letitgo #ritual #naos
alt: A vertical film with soft drone music and no voice. Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, assembles itself out of dust and stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars. One line of text appears at a time and its key word lights up in moon yellow: Full moon tonight. Write down what weighs on you. Say it out loud, once. Leave the page on the window. Now let it go.
